meeting: Business Meeting and Oath of Office Ceremony
title: Approval of the minutes from the City Commission meetings on October 6, October 15, October 20, and October 30, 2025.
notes: 55th Commission. Voice vote, so no roll call. The packet has the minutes of the October 6, 15, 20 and 30, 2025 meetings.

meeting: Business Meeting and Oath of Office Ceremony
title: Remarks by City Commissioners
notes: Former City Manager Ken Collard spoke. Proclamations honoring Commissioner Don Cooney (read by Commissioner Praedel) and Commissioner Qianna Decker (read by Mayor Anderson). Commissioner Cooney distributed a document of his ideas (per minutes).

meeting: Business Meeting and Oath of Office Ceremony
title: Recognition of City Manager Jim Ritsema
notes: Vice Mayor Hess read a proclamation honoring City Manager James K. Ritsema, who spoke about his years of service (per minutes).

meeting: Business Meeting and Oath of Office Ceremony
title: Report from the Board of Canvassers for the Municipal Election held on Tuesday, November 4, 2025.
section: Report of the Board of Canvassers
notes: Certified results of the November 4, 2025 election: David Anderson, Mayor (6,473 votes); Drew Duncan, Commissioner and Vice Mayor (5,820); Stephanie D. Hoffman (4,914); Jacqueline Slaby (4,588) (per minutes).

meeting: Business Meeting and Oath of Office Ceremony
title: Adjournment sine die and Oath of Office
outcome: Adjourned sine die at 5:50 p.m.; oaths administered
notes: City Clerk Borling administered the oath of office to Commissioners Slaby and Hoffman, Vice Mayor Duncan and Mayor Anderson (oath ceremony starts about 0:58:06). The 56th Commission was called to order at 6:02 p.m. (per minutes; about 1:07:05 on video).
